claim.claim-text: 1. A management method (1300) for an access of an electronic device (1210) to a host (1220), characterized by comprising:

receiving (S1302), by a docking station device (110) coupled between the electronic device (1210) and the host (1220), a signal (SG0) of the electronic device (SG0); identifying (S1306) a type of the electronic device (1210) by the docking station device (110) according to the signal (SG0) so as to generate type data (TD0); and determining (S1308), by a backend server (120) communicatively connected to the docking station device (110), whether the electronic device (1210) has a permission to access the host (1220) according to the type data (TD0) received from the docking station device (110) and permission data stored in the backend server so as to send result data (RD0) to the docking station device; and determining by the docking station device (120) according to the result data whether to allow (S1310, S1312) a signal transmission between the electronic device (1210) and the host (1220).

2. The management method (1300) of claim 1, comprising: in response to that the electronic device is determined (S1308) as having low transmission speed, allowing (S1310) the signal transmission between the electronic device and the host.

3. The management method (1300) of claim 1, wherein the step of identifying (S1306) the type of the electronic device is performed in response to that the electronic device is determined (S1304) as having high transmission speed.
4. The management method (1300) of claim 1, further comprising: modifying the permission data to change the type of the electronic device (1210) to which the host is allowed to connect.

5. The management method (1300) of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a plurality of signals (SG0) from a plurality of electronic devices (1210) at the same time and determining whether the signal transmissions between each of the electronic devices and the host should be allowed.
6. The management method (1300) of claim 1, wherein the docking station device (110) comprises:

7. The management method (1300) of claim 6, wherein the control circuit (118) is configured to identify the type of the electronic device (1210) according to the signal (SG0) received from the hub controller (116).

8. The management method (1300) of claim 6, further comprising: transmitting the type data (TD0), from the control circuit (118) through the Internet-of-Thing transceiver circuit (190), to the backend server (120).
9. The management method (1300) of claim 6, further comprising:

receiving a plurality of signals (SG0) by the interface (112) from a plurality of electronic devices (1210); and determining, by the docking station device (110) or the backend server (120), independently for each of the electronic devices (1210), according to the transmission speed or the type of each of the electronic devices (1210), whether to allow signal transmissions between each of the electronic devices (1210) and the host (1220).
